title: Last Ferry — opening and Harbor narration

delivery.intent: One original, warm, gently textured narrator; clear and unhurried, like someone remembering the evening.
delivery.productionMethod: Future offline audition and finished local audio export

playbackPolicy.missingAssetBehavior: Continue with the complete caption and illustration; no delayed catch-up playback.
playbackPolicy.note: The visual endpoint may hold for listening. Do not time-stretch a recording or delay the Next control. Voice timing remains unverified until actual files are supplied.

clips.text:
Your first evening at the helm.
A high tide ahead.
clips.direction: An intimate invitation; let the pause between the two sentences breathe.

clips.text: Pip and Rue have kept a light for you.
clips.direction: Warm recognition of two neighbors and their trust in the captain.

clips.text:
Moss is aboard.
Bring everyone to the lighthouse.
clips.direction: Reassuring, with a clear handoff of purpose to the player.

clips.text:
Pip, Rue and Moss are safe.
Bellwater is still waiting.
clips.direction: A quiet sense of arrival, followed by a gentle invitation to continue.
